The diagonals connect opposite vertices: from (−2, 6) to (6, −2), and from (−2, −2) to (6, 6).

Midpoint of second diagonal: ((−2+6)/2, (−2+6)/2) = (2, 2).

Both diagonals intersect at the same point, the center of the rectangle.
